## What does this help someone do?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. A short before/after example
is useful.

## How did you check it?

Name the flow or commands you used and the result. Include a screenshot or clip
when it explains an interaction. For documentation, check links and examples.

## Anything reviewers should look at closely?

Mention compatibility changes, migrations, or unresolved questions. Remove this
section if there is nothing to call out.
